question.text: Registration of a new Portfolio Manager is governed by which regulation range?

explanation.text: The Logic: The SEBI (Portfolio Managers) Regulations, 2020 group the registration process for a new portfolio manager in the early regulations: application for registration, additional information that SEBI may call for, considerations for grant of registration, and finally the grant of the certificate. This cluster sits in the Reg 7 to Reg 11 range — it is the registration block of the PM Regulations. The Trap: Reg 15-18 of the SEBI (Mutual Funds) Regulations governs mutual-fund registration, not portfolio managers. Reg 5-9 of the AIF Regulations covers Alternative Investment Funds, which is a separate intermediary. The PIT 2015 Regulations deal with prohibition of insider trading, not registration of any intermediary. Note: The cited NISM-Series-XXI-B workbook pages (126-131, 154) reference Regulation 7(2) but do not explicitly specify the full Reg 7-11 range. The framing above reflects the structure of the SEBI (Portfolio Managers) Regulations, 2020, as published by SEBI.
